purpose: User explicitly accepted a no-extra-cost still-panel animatic fallback after video/speech generation was plan-gated.
preserve: Exact original artwork copied unchanged; fit full panels on paper matte, no limbs cropped, no new characters or drawing.
motion: Only restrained 0–2.4% camera scale; contact/pose-critical panels held still. No character rig/walk/lip-sync claimed.
sound: Procedural temporary ambience and foley, no music or spoken voices.
dialogue: Optional raster captions and SRT from exact approved script, planned windows only.
native_ae: Builder source only; AE unavailable, not natively executed.
layers: Each storyboard image is still a flattened illustration. Camera controls, paper background, caption rasters and two sound stems are independently editable; internal characters and scene objects are not separated.
format_note: Square review preserves whole approved panels; widescreen final layout remains a different future task.
